film.title: Manual Rebate: The Browns, the Brook Park Dome and the $193,650 Seat
film.description:
$193,650. That is a price the Cleveland Browns tested for one seat license in their new dome. Not a ticket. The right to buy a ticket.

The Browns are leaving Cleveland's city-owned lakefront stadium for a $2.6 billion dome in Brook Park, out by the airport. This film follows the money: $600 million from Ohio's unclaimed funds, frozen by a Franklin County court; the Modell Law rewritten in the state budget; a stadium site declared "blighted" on the way to a tax deal that steers money from libraries, the Metroparks and Tri-C; seat licenses with fine print; and a plumbing bill sent to the city on the way out.

"Manual rebate" is a term from the 2013 FBI affidavit in the Pilot Flying J case. The company paid a $92 million penalty. Fourteen employees pleaded guilty and three were convicted at trial. Jimmy Haslam said he did not know and was never charged. The comparison between truckers and Browns fans, and the "charges" in this film, are the opinion of Matthew Hagan.

A Hardwood Bricks Productions film, in association with JuiceboxNationTV Entertainment. A 19 North Films film. Written by Matthew Hagan. The narration uses an AI clone of Matthew's voice and an AI reader voice. Original music. Cleveland photos by Hardwood Bricks. News footage from News 5 Cleveland and NFL / Prime Video is excerpted for commentary. Other photo credits are on screen and in the end card.

Sources: cleveland.com (Rich Exner, Aug., Sept. and Oct. 2026); Crain's Cleveland Business (Nov. 2026); NEOtrans (Aug. 20, 2026); News 5 Cleveland; Signal Cleveland; Statehouse News Bureau (Mar. 2026); Ideastream (Nov. 2013); WUOT and Chattanooga Times Free Press (2013); Heavy Duty Trucking (Nov. 2018); Front Office Sports; CNBC (Oct. 2024); NFL.com/AP and WVXU (2025).

reels.title: $193,650 for the right to buy one Browns ticket
reels.text: The Browns are leaving the lakefront for a $2.6 billion dome by the airport. The bill for it is yours. Twice.

reels.title: Jacking what, Jimmy?
reels.text: The FBI affidavit had names for it: jacking the discount, manual rebates. Browns fans have seen this paperwork before.
